notes.title: The Release Date is April 27th!
notes.notes:
Вы можете прочитать эту новость на русском языке:
http://steamcommunity.com/games/562210/announcements/detail/1299695420516498242?l=russian

Dear future players!

I'm excited to announce that we have almost finished our work on the game, so it'll be released on April 27th.

Thank you everyone who was looking forward to it release, we'll be happy to see each one of you on the release day!

Rock on, and have a nice weekend!
